capabilities: Render graphviz-tagged code blocks as diagrams in Reading view, Live Preview, embeds, hover previews, Canvas cards and exported PDFs
Toggle each diagram between the rendered graph and its DOT source
Add captions, alignment, alt text and CSS classes to graphs via block options
Open clickable http, https and mailto links in nodes and edges
Adapt graph colors and labels to dark and light themes
extras: Works fully offline with Graphviz bundled in the plugin; no internet connection or data collection. Blocks tagged dot are left as plain code; images in labels (image=, ) are unsupported and blocks are capped at 64,000 characters.
problem: Obsidian only renders Mermaid diagrams, so graphs written in Graphviz's DOT language stay as plain code blocks.

relations.evidence: Graphs are drawn by Graphviz, through Viz.js.
